title: Clock in with Face Scan
subtitle: Time in, break and time out in a few seconds

steps.caption: Tap Face Scan
steps.detail: It's the round button in the middle of the bottom bar. You can also tap Clock-In/Out.

steps.caption: Wait a moment while Paylalo gets ready
steps.detail: It checks your work area, your registered face, the camera and the connection.

steps.caption: Tap the punch you need
steps.detail: Clock In, Break Out, Break In or Clock Out. The next one is already picked for you.

steps.caption: Centre your face and tap Capture
steps.detail: Hold the phone at eye level in good light.

steps.caption: Follow the on-screen prompts
steps.detail: Turn your head or blink when asked. A photo or video can't pass this check.

steps.caption: Done. Your punch is saved
steps.detail: You'll see the time and where it was recorded. Tap Done.

title: Register your face
subtitle: Do this once so Face Scan knows it's you

steps.caption: Open Profile, tap Face Recognition
steps.detail: Profile is the last button on the bottom bar.

steps.caption: Tap Register face
steps.detail: Read the biometric consent, tick the box and tap Agree & continue. Then take a clear photo in good light.

steps.caption: Wait for approval
steps.detail: An owner, admin or manager checks your photo. Owners and admins don't need to wait.

steps.caption: Your face is enrolled
steps.detail: Now you can clock in with Face Scan. Tap Re-register any time to update your photo.

title: File a request
subtitle: Leave, overtime, undertime, time fix, holiday and rest-day work
outro: Your request is on its way.

steps.caption: Tap Requests, then Add
steps.detail: Pick the request you need. You only see the types your company allows for you.

steps.caption: Leave: pick the type and dates
steps.detail: Read the filing rules at the top first. Your leave credits are shown above them.

steps.caption: Add a reason, then tap Submit
steps.detail: Attach photos if you have them, like a medical certificate.

steps.caption: Overtime: set the date and times
steps.detail: Choose Pre-Shift OT or Post-Shift OT. Overtime is paid only once it's approved.

steps.caption: Time Fix: pick what to correct
steps.detail: Clock In, Clock Out, Both, or Missed Entry if you forgot to punch. Then enter the right times.

steps.caption: Holiday Work: pick the holiday
steps.detail: Set the date and start time, add a reason and tap Submit Request.

title: Approve or reject requests
subtitle: Handle your team's requests in one place
outro: Your team gets an answer right away.

steps.caption: Open Monitoring, then Approvals
steps.detail: All Pending shows everything waiting. Use the chips to see one type at a time.

steps.caption: Tap a request to open it
steps.detail: Check the date, the time asked for and the reason.

steps.caption: Tap Approve, then Approve again
steps.detail: You can add a reason for the record. It's optional.

steps.caption: Or tap Reject
steps.detail: Add a reason so the employee knows why, then tap Reject.

steps.caption: Changed your mind? Revert to Pending
steps.detail: The request goes back to the queue so you can decide again.

title: Check your attendance
subtitle: Your punches, hours, lates and schedule
outro: You always know where you stand.

steps.caption: Tap Attendance on Yours
steps.detail: See your working days, hours and total lates, then every punch day by day.

steps.caption: Tap the month to change it
steps.detail: Pick any month, or All for the whole year.

steps.caption: Tap Your Shift
steps.detail: See your current schedule, grace period and lunch break for each day.

steps.caption: Scroll for past schedules
steps.detail: Custom days are one-off changes for a single date.

steps.caption: Wrong punch? File a Time Fix
steps.detail: Go to Requests, tap Add, then Time Fix. Your manager approves it.

title: View your payslip
subtitle: What you earned, what was deducted, what you got

steps.caption: Tap Payslip on Yours
steps.detail: Each pay period shows gross pay, deductions and net pay.

steps.caption: Tap a pay period to open it
steps.detail: Earnings come first: basic pay, overtime, holiday premium and add-ons.

steps.caption: Scroll down to your net pay
steps.detail: Deductions and loan balances are listed before the final amount.

steps.caption: Tap Ledger for regular deductions
steps.detail: See SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG and tax, and when each one is taken.

steps.caption: Track your loans to zero
steps.detail: Each loan shows the amount per cutoff and what's left to pay.

title: Add and invite employees
subtitle: New people join by QR code or link; existing users by invitation

steps.caption: Open Org, then Employees
steps.detail: Tap Add at the top of the list.

steps.caption: Tap + Add and choose
steps.detail: New to Paylalo for someone without an account. Already has an account for someone who does.

steps.caption: New person: enter name and email
steps.detail: Tap Create login. Paylalo emails them a temporary password to change at first sign-in.

steps.caption: Find them under Created
steps.detail: Open Pending Invitations. New accounts wait here until the person signs in.

steps.caption: Tap View code to show the QR
steps.detail: Ask them to scan it from the Paylalo sign-up screen. The code is valid for 30 days.

steps.caption: Or tap Copy link and send it
steps.detail: Opening the link joins them to your company. No code to type.

steps.caption: Has an account? Invite existing user
steps.detail: Type their email, phone or account name and tap Send invitation.

steps.caption: Finish their setup
steps.detail: New people show Needs setup. Open them and fill in Schedule, Location and Pay & benefits.

title: Set up work schedules
subtitle: Shift times, lunch breaks and who works when

steps.caption: Open Org, then Schedules
steps.detail: See every schedule, with its days, times, grace period and lunch break.

steps.caption: Tap + Add, then New Schedule
steps.detail: Name it, pick Full shift or Broken schedule, then choose the working days.

steps.caption: Set times, then Create Schedule
steps.detail: Turn on Allow lunch break if needed. Days you didn't pick are rest days.

steps.caption: Tap Assign to open Assignments
steps.detail: Each schedule shows how many employees are on it.

steps.caption: Tap + Assign and pick employees
steps.detail: Choose the schedule and start date, then tap Review Assignment.

title: Set up work locations
subtitle: Where your team is allowed to clock in

steps.caption: Open Org, then Locations
steps.detail: Tap + Add to create a new work location.

steps.caption: Search for the place
steps.detail: The pin on the map marks the centre of the work area.

steps.caption: Pick a size, name it, Submit
steps.detail: Small Shop, Office Building, Office Complex or Campus. You can also set a custom radius.

steps.caption: Tap Assign to see who goes where
steps.detail: Each location shows how many people are assigned to it.

steps.caption: Tap + Assign and pick employees
steps.detail: Choose the location and start date, then tap Review Assignment.

title: Set the payout schedule
subtitle: When people get paid, and which days each payday covers

steps.caption: Open Org Rules, tap Payout Schedule
steps.detail: Org Rules is the first tile on the Org tab.

steps.caption: Tap + Add payout schedule
steps.detail: This is the source of truth for every pay run.

steps.caption: Name it, pick the pay frequency
steps.detail: Then set the days each payout covers and the day people are paid.

steps.caption: Set when it starts
steps.detail: Choose the first payday, what happens on weekends or holidays, and the filing cut-off.

steps.caption: Pick when contributions are deducted
steps.detail: Choose SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG and Tax under each payout.

steps.caption: Tap Create payout schedule
steps.detail: Then tap Create to confirm.

steps.caption: Open Org Rules, tap Deduction Rules
steps.detail: It has three tabs: Lates, Government and Ledger.

steps.caption: Lates: set the late charge
steps.detail: Turn on Deduct for lates and set the rate per minute late.

steps.caption: Government: check contributions
steps.detail: SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG and withholding tax, based on the monthly basic salary.

steps.caption: Ledger: loans and other deductions
steps.detail: Active items are deducted every payday.

steps.caption: Tap Save rules, choose when
steps.detail: Effective next payday, or Reflect on the open payroll. Then tap Confirm.

steps.caption: Open Payroll, then Run Payroll
steps.detail: Read the checklist first: timesheet, deductions and add-ons must be final.

steps.caption: Pick the schedule and who to include
steps.detail: Choose By type, By team or Manual, then tap Calculate.

steps.caption: Check the timesheet
steps.detail: Unapproved requests aren't counted. Tap Timesheet is correct.

steps.caption: Check deductions, tap Continue
steps.detail: Government contributions and loan installments for this run.

steps.caption: Review adjustments, tap Calculate
steps.detail: Only approved add-ons and deductions are included.

steps.caption: Check the totals and payslips
steps.detail: Owners tap Finalize. Admins tap Submit for Approval instead.

steps.caption: Tap Finalize to lock it
steps.detail: A finalized run can't be changed, so check everything first.

title: Monitor your team
subtitle: Timesheet, photo checks and weekly reports
outro: You know how your team is doing.

steps.caption: Open Monitoring, then Timesheet
steps.detail: See days present, total lates and days absent for the date range.

steps.caption: Tap a name to see each day
steps.detail: Change the dates at the top. The download button exports the timesheet.

steps.caption: Open Photo Check
steps.detail: Compare each clock-in and clock-out photo with the registered face.

steps.caption: Open Weekly Reports
steps.detail: See this week's tardy days, absences and approved leave at a glance.

steps.caption: Find who needs attention
steps.detail: Each person gets a score: Action Required, At Risk, On Track or Elite.

title: Check your inbox
subtitle: Approvals, payslips and reminders in one place

steps.caption: Tap Inbox in the bottom bar
steps.detail: New items have a dot. The badge shows how many are unread.

steps.caption: Use the tabs to filter
steps.detail: All, Requests, Payroll or Reminders.

steps.caption: Tap Mark all as read
steps.detail: Or use Unread and Read to show only some items.

steps.caption: Choose what alerts you get
steps.detail: Tap the settings icon next to Mark all as read. Turn each type on or off.

title: Profile, password and security
subtitle: Keep your details and your account safe
outro: Your account is up to date.

steps.caption: Tap Profile in the bottom bar
steps.detail: All your personal settings are here.

steps.caption: Tap Profile details to edit
steps.detail: Change your photo, mobile number or address. Your employer sets your pay and schedule.

steps.caption: Tap Password & Security
steps.detail: It's under Account settings.

steps.caption: Pick what to change
steps.detail: Forgot your password or MPIN? Tap Forgot and enter the 6-digit code we email you.

steps.caption: Fill in all three, Update password
steps.detail: Change MPIN works the same way, with a 4-digit code.

steps.caption: Check your devices and sessions
steps.detail: Don't recognise one? Tap Unlink or Sign out.
